description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle data source and persistence model to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including JDBC, JPA configuration, schema definitions, SQL syntax, and photo BLOB storage.
tasks.reason: The application currently depends on Oracle-specific JDBC, Hibernate, SQL, and BLOB features. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service, with Managed Identity as the planned authentication method.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL, using Managed Identity instead of plaintext database credentials. Convert Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including migrating photo BLOB data to PostgreSQL bytea. Update the datasource configuration to use the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint.
